description: A shell script for managing package download, verification, and post-processing in a device management system, including packager invocation, signature validation, container handling, and cleanup.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file upon script exit.

methods.name: generateDownloadUrl
methods.description: Generates a JSON-RPC request to obtain a download URL from the security utility.

methods.name: sendRequestToPackager
methods.description: Sends a curl request to the packager and checks the response.

methods.name: invokePackager
methods.description: Invokes the packager with retries, waits for completion, and handles success or failure.
